YOUR LITTLE BIG MISSION01—03

Catch the
last tram.

You can't do everything at once.
But yesterday's you can help.

  1. 01
    A ticket to tomorrow

    Find the glowing ticket kiosk.
    Walk close, then press E.

  2. 02
    A bridge across time

    Stand on the amber pad.
    Press R to leave an echo.

  3. 03
    One last connection

    Leave another echo on the blue power pad. Then board the tram.
